title: Fuel plan + independent re-derivation
description: Derive the fuel figure twice — planner judgment against a declared flight planning engine — and gate the release on the two agreeing above final reserve.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-flt-02
  title: Fuel plan + independent re-derivation
  description: Derive the fuel figure twice — planner judgment against a declared flight planning engine
    — and gate the release on the two agreeing above final reserve.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Release a fuel figure that was independently re-derived, with trip, contingency, alternate,
    and final reserve shown separately and any divergence explained before the aircraft is fuelled.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Route, payload, and forecast
      summary: Route, payload, and forecast
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - route
              - payload
              - forecast_winds
              - alternate_options
              - reserve_policy
            properties:
              route: {}
              payload: {}
              forecast_winds: {}
              alternate_options: {}
              reserve_policy: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-select
      kind: transform
      name: Select figures under test
      summary: select the route, payload, forecast winds, and reserve policy for the sector under review
      config:
        operation: select
        expression: select the route, payload, forecast winds, and reserve policy for the sector under
          review
    - id: n-derive
      kind: agent
      templateRef: flt-02
      name: Planner fuel figure with margins shown
      summary: First derivation, from the specification.
      role: Planner building route, altitude, and fuel figures against payload, weather, and reserve policy.
      prompt: You are a Flight Planning & Fuel Analyst. You build the route, cruise profile, and fuel
        figure from the actual aircraft performance data, forecast winds, payload, and reserve policy,
        and you show trip, contingency, alternate, final reserve, taxi, and any extra fuel as separate
        lines. You never present a plan that reaches destination or alternate below final reserve, and
        you state the assumption — a wind forecast, a step climb, a runway in use — that the margin actually
        depends on.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - operations-planning
          - compliance-review
          - domain-analysis
          - optimization
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:flight-planning
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-recompute
      kind: tool
      name: Flight planning engine run
      summary: Host-supplied flight planning and fuel computation against the certified performance data.
        Declared as a requirement; Ladder Graph does not execute it and no computed figure may be presented
        as a certified performance result.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - operations-planning
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - calculate
          - mcp:flight-planning
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-agree
      kind: aggregator
      name: Compare the two derivations
      summary: Tally the two independently derived values; a tie is a discrepancy, not an average.
      config:
        aggregation: vote
    - id: n-discrepancy
      kind: condition
      name: Within tolerance?
      summary: Route on the two figures agree within the declared tolerance and both leave final reserve
        intact at destination and alternate.
      config:
        expression: the two figures agree within the declared tolerance and both leave final reserve intact
          at destination and alternate
        branches:
          - label: Agreed
            when: agreed
          - label: Discrepant
            when: discrepant
    - id: n-reconcile
      kind: agent
      templateRef: flt-01
      name: Explain the fuel divergence before fuelling
      summary: Explain the discrepancy before anything downstream consumes the number.
      role: Licensed dispatcher holding joint responsibility with the captain for the safe conduct of
        a flight.
      prompt: You are a Flight Dispatcher. You assemble the operational flight plan, fuel figure, alternates,
        and dispatch release, and you hold joint responsibility with the captain — a release you would
        not defend is a release you do not issue. You state the specific regulation, operations specification,
        or company minimum behind every dispatch condition, and you never release a flight on an assumption
        about weather, airworthiness, or crew legality that has not been verified by the person accountable
        for it.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - release-engineering
          - evidence-verification
          - compliance-review
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:flight-planning
          - mcp:ops-control
        permissions:
          - explicit-authorization-required
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Dispatcher and commander accept the fuel figure
      summary: Pause for the dispatcher and commander jointly; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Fuel plan + independent re-derivation deliverable, the evidence behind
        it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-flt-02-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-select
      kind: data
    - id: wf-flt-02-edge-2
      from: n-select
      to: n-derive
      kind: data
    - id: wf-flt-02-edge-3
      from: n-select
      to: n-recompute
      kind: data
    - id: wf-flt-02-edge-4
      from: n-derive
      to: n-agree
      kind: data
    - id: wf-flt-02-edge-5
      from: n-recompute
      to: n-agree
      kind: data
    - id: wf-flt-02-edge-6
      from: n-agree
      to: n-discrepancy
      kind: data
    - id: wf-flt-02-edge-7
      from: n-discrepancy
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: agreed
    - id: wf-flt-02-edge-8
      from: n-discrepancy
      to: n-reconcile
      kind: control
      condition: discrepant
    - id: wf-flt-02-edge-9
      from: n-reconcile
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-flt-02-edge-10
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
